primType is unexpected : undef_f32 Expected : acl_f32
root_cause: Only 1 of 71,639 tests failed: a single ACL-backed AvgPool CPU functional test on ARM64 asserted that the selected primitive implementation type was 'acl_f32' but the runtime picked 'undef_f32' instead. This is the same known recurring ACL primitive-selection flakiness (ARM Compute Library heuristics choosing a different/undefined primitive type for certain AvgPool/Convert/MatMul shapes depending on runner load or ACL version/threading), previously seen for FC/MatMul/Convert layer tests and now observed for AvgPool. The failing test file (src/plugins/intel_cpu/tests/functional/utils/cpu_test_utils.cpp) and test target are entirely unrelated to the PR's actual change (GPU SDPA reference kernel FP16 normalization: sdpa_ref.cl / sdpa_gpu_test.cpp), confirming this is pre-existing CPU/ARM64 test flakiness unrelated to PR #38528.
reproduction_steps: Build CPU plugin for ARM64 (Ubuntu 22.04 cross-compilation) and run: ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter=*smoke_AvgPool_CPU_4D/PoolingLayerCPUTest.CompareWithRefs*acl* repeatedly; the ACL primitive-type assertion in cpu_test_utils.cpp:248 fails intermittently depending on ACL's runtime kernel selection.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed CPU functional tests job; this is a known flaky ACL primitive-selection assertion unrelated to the PR diff.

Track the recurring ACL primType mismatch (undef_f32 vs acl_f32) across AvgPool/FC/MatMul/Convert layer tests as a single ARM64 CPU-plugin flakiness ticket and consider relaxing/retrying the primTypeCheck assertion or adding ACL-implementation-selection diagnostics.
No action required on PR #38528 itself (GPU SDPA fix) - the failure is confined to an unrelated CPU/ARM64 test.
prevention_strategies: Add a short internal retry (or gtest repeat) for the primTypeCheck assertion in cpu_test_utils.cpp specifically for ACL-backed primitives, since ACL's kernel/primitive selection can legitimately vary by runtime/thread count; alternatively, log the actual selected primitive alongside expected to aid triage without failing on a single mismatch when results are still numerically correct.
historical_context: This is the 4th recorded occurrence of the 'primType is unexpected ... undef_f32 Expected : acl_f32' signature (pattern eb0b94c864ee1a85, first seen 2026-09-11, previously affecting PRs #37783, #37885, #38052). Closely related sibling signatures (76751669c7a78fcd, 0de8f57e3fb03230, 7c36e50cffda3cd7) show the same ACL primitive-selection flakiness across ConvertCPULayerTest, MatMulLayerCPUTest, and MatMulDecompressConvertTest since July 2026.
